title: Patch: Signature only on Full art + Animated, with its own art and motion; Full art offered on a varied set of cards
notes: The owner's answers to #2725's open questions 2 and 3. Signature (Mythic) stays its own augment, owned card by card, but is worn only beside the Full art version and the Animated augment, each owned and offered on the card: the server refuses a pick naming it without both with a 400 and writes nothing, a change that leaves a held one without them drops it, and a match freezes it only beside both (R2949000). With it on, the face shows the Signature look: the Full art face with a picture of its own, the card's painter seeded apart, and a motion of its own with silver ink, plus the signature, base and Radiant, no gold (R2725004); the signature over the normal face's art window is gone, and a retired Mythic, which owns all three, now shows the Signature look. An offer clause may take a seeded share of its cards: Full art's offer narrows from 243 cards to 157, 60 in 100 of its Rare and Epic Units and its Legendaries and Mythics with the 21 full-art cards always in, at least its floor in every shipped set; Signature is offered where both are (155), and Animated does not change (R2949001). How cards look only: nothing plays differently.

player.title: Signature on Full art and Animated
new: Signature now has a look of its own: a full art and an animation that no other version has, with the card's name signed across it.
changes: Signature is worn only on a card that also wears Full art and Animated. In the Collection it waits until both are on, and turning either off turns it off.
Signature no longer signs the normal card face.
Full art is now offered on a varied set of cards rather than every Rare and Epic Unit and every Legendary and Mythic, so cards differ. Every card that had a full art before keeps it.
A signed full art you already own still counts as all three, and now shows the Signature look.
